page.overview:
Who is Alison Smith?

Alison Smith was an employee who worked by the British Secret Intelligence Service (SIS/MI6). She was portrayed by Amy Morgan, the character appeared in the 2021 James Bond film No Time to Die.

While Bond and Nomi went to visit M she met with the pair.
